verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 is a platform with an official management software ecosystem (Mission Control, health monitoring, and Redfish/IPMI BMC interfaces), so an official MCP server is plausible and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server, though. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes show only that the documentation is readable by AI agents, not that an agent can connect through MCP.
